evidence_sentence: The workshop description explicitly names this as Saggar Firing with materials and techniques specific to saggar firing.
evidence_quote: In this two part workshop students will have the opportunity to create one of a kind Saggar fired wares using feathers, horse hair, sugar and other combustibles.
summary: Two-part saggar firing workshop where intermediate students prepare bisqued pieces with terra sig and mica powder, then fire with combustible materials like feathers and horse hair. Led by Mary Holden-Hall.
